question_text: Explain how OLAP could help a museum examine admission totals by site, visitor category and month.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: OLAP supports examining aggregated data across these dimensions. Staff can compare sites or focus on one category and time period, revealing seasonal or demographic patterns that inform staffing and exhibition planning.
